headline.title: We searched "chiropractor Llandaff Cardiff". Pages about you appeared 10 times. Your own website appeared 0 times.
headline.detail: WhatClinic, Bupa, Doklist, Bark, Poyst and others describe you in their own words, several under your old name, "Llandaff Chiropractic Clinic". People never reach the page where you tell your own story.

summary: The Llandaff Clinic has 295 reviews, all five stars, and consultants who refer patients to Andrew. But in our search for a chiropractor in Llandaff, ten directory pages appeared and your own website none, while clinics in Whitchurch and Canton with 333–420 reviews compete for the same patients.

you.notes: Chiro + physio + podiatry; to 8pm Mon–Thu, Saturdays

search.result: WhatClinic came first (under your old name, Llandaff Chiropractic Clinic), then Bupa, Doklist (twice), Bark, Poyst (twice), your booking page, GetFitPages and MyMediTravel. Your website (cardiffchiropractor.com) did not appear in the 18 results.
search.meaning: Patients meet ten versions of you written by other people, some with an old name, and none written by you.

visibility: In our search for a chiropractor in Llandaff, directories filled the page and your own website didn't appear. Several directories still use your old name, which can confuse people comparing clinics.
lead: 295 reviews, all five stars; consultants refer patients to you.
Chiropractic, physiotherapy and podiatry (including surgery) under one roof.
Open until 8pm Monday to Thursday and on Saturdays.
lose: Clinics in Canton and Whitchurch have 333–420 reviews.
One of them takes bookings until 9pm on most weekdays.
Your own website didn't appear in our search; directory pages did, some under an old name.

gaps.title: Two names, one clinic
gaps.detail: Directories show "Llandaff Chiropractic Clinic" while you're now The Llandaff Clinic, so patients comparing options may not realise it's you.

gaps.title: Your physio and podiatry are hidden
gaps.detail: People searching for a physio or podiatrist in Llandaff don't learn you offer both.

gaps.title: Directories frame you as one of many
gaps.detail: WhatClinic and Bark list alternatives right next to you.

actions.title: Make your own website the first result for Llandaff
actions.why: With 295 five-star reviews and consultant referrals, being found is the missing piece.

actions.title: Update your name on WhatClinic, Doklist and other directories
actions.why: Doable today: one consistent name stops patients wondering if it's the same clinic.

actions.title: Give physiotherapy and podiatry their own pages
actions.why: Those patients search by service, not by clinic name.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your team, specialties and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each visit, so happy patients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Reminders and recall
plan.detail: Follow-up and maintenance reminders that go out by themselves.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against nearby clinics, and what to do next.

scenario: A cyclist in Danescourt hurts his back on Thursday evening. He searches "chiropractor Llandaff", sees a directory listing an older clinic name, isn't sure it's still open, and books a Canton clinic open until 9pm. The clinic with 295 five-star reviews and consultant referrals, ten minutes away, loses him. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your patients keep giving you five stars and consultants keep referring. But people searching by area keep meeting directories, old names and other clinics first.
